resolved_blockers: Permanent unavailability consumes the exact request and resumes ordinary collection, including target tail.
Request absence/presence, path, SHA and pilot identity are bound at launch, cycle, active recovery and commit.
Preparation-time frozen reference has immutable scalar/entry/raw schema; append-only new successes coexist without refreshing it.

validation_scope.note: Protocol 'no patterns' means no prepared 16-row pilot cohort; design review checked transient geometry candidates only.

adoption.next_action: Implement and verify the optional one-shot factory-native pilot; then prepare a versioned request and concrete cohort before dispatch.
adoption.after_pilot: All valid truth feeds ordinary SM updates; no automatic repeat.

limits: Design PASS is not an implementation, dispatch or HFSS pass.
Pilot comparisons are against a fixed preparation-time reference, not a then-current global-best or campaign-first claim.
No symmetry causation, spec pass, repeat certification, local exhaustion or research completion is established.
